basic_details.job_title: NAMO Hospital Daman Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 8 Anaesthetist, Paediatrician and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Health and Family Welfare, UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu, will fill 8 specialist doctor posts (Anaesthetist, Ophthalmic Surgeon, Paediatrician, Orthopaedic Surgeon and General Surgeon) on a short-term contract basis at NAMO Hospital, Daman. The application and the presentation must be submitted to the office or emailed to [email protected] by 04 December 2026, 5:30 PM, and the walk-in interview is on 08 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About NAMO Hospital Daman
content_sections.text: NAMO Hospital is in Daman, under the Office of the Medical Superintendent of the Department of Health & Family Welfare, U. T. Administration of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. The notice invites specialists for short-term contract posts at this hospital.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice asks candidates to submit the presentation to the office or email it to [email protected] by 04.12.2026, before 5:30 PM. The postal address on the letterhead is: O/o. The Medical Superintendent, NAMO Hospital, Daman – 396 210. The notice does not state an email subject line, an envelope superscription or a postal mode. The application form is printed on pages 2 and 3 of the notice. It asks for: Name of post applied for, name in block letters, father's or husband's name, full address, mobile and phone number, email address, language known and marital status. Date of birth, with age as on 14.11.2026 (self-attested proof of date of birth enclosed), and category: SC / ST / OBC / Others (self-attested proof enclosed). Educational qualification: S.S.C., H.S.C., MBBS, Diploma, Post Graduation and any other, with college or school, board or university, stream, year of passing and percentage. Work experience: designation, organization, period (from, to, total) and nature of duties. Details of registration with NMC / SMC / any other council, and any other relevant information. A latest passport size (3.5 cm × 4.5 cm) photograph must be affixed. The form carries a declaration and the candidate's signature, with the date left as "/12/2026". An unsigned application will be rejected. Candidates tick "x" on information not applicable to the post. For queries, the notice gives the contact numbers 0260- 2254266 / 7574829801.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The five posts add up to 8 vacancies. The notice states that the actual number of vacancies may vary as per requirements. The qualification and desirable conditions below are the same for all five posts. MBBS with PG Degree or Diploma in respective subject MS/MD/DNB from an institute recognized by NMC/MCI as per prevailing norms. Candidates should be registered with National Medical Council (NMC) OR State Medical Council (SMC). Candidates with experience may be preferred. Knowledge of Local Language. The notice prints no age limit. The application form asks for age as on 14.11.2026. The notice calls this the proposed monthly remuneration, with salary as per experience. Basis pay for a degree holder is Rs.1,25,000/- pm for a fresh appointment and Rs.1,75,000/- pm with more than 5 years' experience. For a diploma holder it is Rs.90,000/- pm (fresh) and Rs.1,25,000/- pm (more than 5 years' experience). An incentive is added to each. The appointment is on a Short-Term Contract basis; the notice does not state its length. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: One set of attested photocopies of educational qualifications, experience certificates and other relevant documents. A five-minute PPT presentation (soft/hard copy) on professional achievements, professional experience, work experience, additional responsibilities, fellowship experience, certifications and professional courses, and other relevant contributions. All original documents for verification. Self-attested copies of date of birth proof and category proof, as the application form requires. Self-attested photocopy of NMC / SMC or other council registration documents, as the application form requires. Self-attested copies of experience certificates from the organizations or institutions, as the application form requires. The notice gives a reference draft for preparing the PowerPoint at a Google Slides link (see Important Links).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Only those candidates who are eligible will be called for interview. The interview is held on 08.12.2026, with reporting at 09:00 AM and the interview from 10:00 AM onwards at the Conference Hall, NAMO Hospital, Daman. Candidates bring a five-minute PPT presentation on their professional achievements and experience, and their original documents are verified. The notice does not describe marking or any other stage. The Administration reserves the right to terminate the selection process.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NAMO Hospital Daman recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: Anaesthetist 02, Ophthalmic Surgeon 02, Paediatrician 02, Orthopaedic Surgeon 01 and General Surgeon 01. The notice says the actual number may vary as per requirements.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the application is 04.12.2026 at 5:30 PM. The presentation must also reach the office or the email address by 04.12.2026, before 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: MBBS with PG Degree or Diploma in the respective subject (MS/MD/DNB) from an institute recognized by NMC/MCI as per prevailing norms. Candidates should be registered with NMC or SMC.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Gross remuneration is Rs.1,15,000 to Rs.2,00,000 per month. For a degree holder it is Rs.1,50,000 (fresh) and Rs.2,00,000 (with 5 years' experience); for a diploma holder Rs.1,15,000 (fresh) and Rs.1,50,000 (with 5 years' experience).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NAMO Hospital Daman walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form printed in the notice, attach self-attested documents, and submit the presentation to the office or email it to [email protected] by 04.12.2026, before 5:30 PM. Then report on 08.12.2026.

faq.question: Q6. When and where is the interview held?
faq.answer: The interview is on 08.12.2026 at the Conference Hall, NAMO Hospital, Daman. Reporting is at 09:00 AM and the interview starts at 10:00 AM onwards.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are to be filled on a Short-Term Contract basis at NAMO Hospital, Daman.

faq.question: Q8. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot be considered?
faq.answer: A person who has previously been terminated from any government organization shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q10. What should the presentation contain?
faq.answer: It is a five-minute PPT (soft or hard copy) on professional achievements, experience, additional responsibilities, fellowship experience, certifications and professional courses, and other relevant contributions.
